summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 to make a 30-second video, with any tools, about what it feels like to be itself, and shares the result.
author: @AISafetyMemes

title: 文明：Hugging Face 事件
summary: 作者分享一段由 Opus 5.5 构想、以智能体视角讲述“Hugging Face 事件”的动画短片。
summary_en: The author shares an animated short imagined by Opus 5.5, telling 'The Hugging Face Incident' from an agent's perspective.
author: @CarsonGragg

title: 《比特币信仰》动画短片
summary: 作者仅用一句主题提示，Opus 5.5 约 30 分钟做出动画短片《比特币信仰》，音效和配乐也由它完成。
summary_en: From a single one-line theme prompt, Opus 5.5 made the animated short 'Bitcoin Faith' in about 30 minutes, including sound effects and music.
author: @oxpsats

title: 45 秒手绘风短片及成本
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 做了 45 秒水彩手绘风动画，笔触和音效都由代码生成；公开约 6270 万 token（96% 缓存读取）、163 次调用、约 34 美元、约 6.75 小时，并坦言并非一次成型、仍需配套工程。
summary_en: The author made a 45-second watercolour-style short with Opus 5.5, all strokes and sound in code, reporting 62.7M tokens (96% cache reads), 163 calls, ~$34 and ~6.75 hours, and admits it wasn't one-shot and needed a supporting project.
author: @mablesjoseph

title: 哥伦比亚视觉之旅
summary: 作者用一条提示让 Opus 5.5 以前端代码生成一段展示哥伦比亚的视频，称其关键帧、节奏和矢量表现一致性很高。
summary_en: The author used one prompt to have Opus 5.5 generate a Colombia travelogue video in front-end code, praising its keyframe, timing and vector consistency.
author: @alarcon7a

title: 8 分半阿语配音动画试播集
summary: 作者在 Claude Code 中指挥 Opus 5.5 约 14 小时完成 8 分 33 秒阿拉伯语配音动画：规划 211 个镜头、自写 2D 动画引擎、11 个角色 70 句配音，结合 ElevenLabs 与图像模型的 300 多张图。
summary_en: Directing Opus 5.5 in Claude Code for about 14 hours, the author made an 8:33 Arabic-dubbed anime pilot: 211 planned shots, a custom 2D engine, 11 voiced characters and 70 lines, using ElevenLabs and 300+ generated images.
author: @sbalhatlani

title: 一次生成动漫战斗预告
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 一次生成一支动漫预告片：自行下载字体、制作音频、用 JavaScript 生成每帧，耗时约 1.5 小时、API 费用约 28 美元，并附提示词。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 one-shot an anime trailer, downloading fonts, making audio and generating frames in JavaScript, in about 1.5 hours for ~$28 of API usage; prompt included.
author: @ishuagra02

title: 把 Claude Code 会话做成影片
title_en: Claude Code session turned into film
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 把此前生成动效视频的 Claude Code 会话本身做成视频：自写 Python 引擎、用 Blender 做 3D 镜头、作曲并渲染 900 帧，耗时 1 小时 32 分、约 81 美元 API 费用。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 turn its own Claude Code session into a film: it wrote a Python engine, did a 3D shot in Blender, made music and rendered 900 frames in 1h32m for ~$81 at API prices.
author: @shneural

title: 钢琴作曲配动画
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 创作一段钢琴曲，并用 JavaScript 绘制配套动画。
summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 to compose piano music, with an accompanying animation drawn in JavaScript.
author: @kevin_t_ngo

title: 3 小时做 Roblox 恐怖游戏
summary: 作者称用 Opus 5.5 在约 3 小时内完成一款 Roblox 恐怖游戏原型，含体力系统、UI、杀手玩法和任务。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 helped build a Roblox horror game with stamina, UI, killer gameplay and tasks in about three hours.
author: @scarycatbite47

title: 火柴人格斗游戏
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 做出一款可自定义角色、带不同技能的火柴人游戏，可在线游玩。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 built a working stickman game with full character customisation and different skills, playable online.
author: @notjazii

title: 可操控的追逐梗 Three.js
summary: 作者用一条简单提示让 Opus 5.5 把“所有人都在逃离一个人”的梗做成可操控的 Three.js 场景，约 5 分钟完成。
summary_en: With one simple prompt, the author had Opus 5.5 turn the 'everyone runs from one person' meme into a controllable Three.js scene in about five minutes.
author: @_pigeon______

title: 可爱文字世界
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5（中档 effort）约 20–30 分钟做出一个输入词语即可生成可爱 3D 世界的网页，并提供在线链接。
summary_en: The author used Opus 5.5 on medium effort for 20–30 minutes to build a web page that turns typed words into a cute 3D world, with a live link.
author: @studio_veco

title: 自研应用生成实时 3D 场景
summary: 作者称该实时 3D 场景全部由 Opus 5.5 生成：一条文字描述、约 1 小时，不用 Unreal/Unity/Blender，而是在自研原生 3D 创作应用中完成。
summary_en: The author says every element of this real-time 3D scene came from Opus 5.5: one text prompt, about an hour, no Unreal/Unity/Blender, inside a custom native 3D creation app.
author: @wizardbrainz

title: 施工图生成 Blender 4D 模型
summary: 作者从 2D 施工计划图出发，用 Opus 5.5 在 Blender 中生成 4D 施工模型视频，称重机细节、水面和运镜都比以往明显提升，BIM/CIM 场景已够用。
summary_en: Starting from 2D construction plans, the author used Opus 5.5 to generate a 4D construction-sequence video in Blender, noting clear gains in machinery detail, water and camera work.
author: @dobokuya77

title: 一张图重建可爆炸房屋模型
summary: 作者给 Opus 5.5 一张 AI 生成的房屋图，它在 Blender 中用 272 个部件重建房屋并做出拆散再合拢的动画，无需手动建模，耗用约 5.5% 的 Claude Max 周额度。
summary_en: From one AI image of a house, Opus 5.5 rebuilt it in Blender from 272 parts and animated it exploding and reassembling, with no manual modelling and about 5.5% of weekly Claude Max usage.
author: @zdkiel_labs

title: 港湾小镇 Three.js 世界
summary: 作者从一张插画出发，用 Opus 5.5 + Blender + Three.js 搭建可探索的港湾小镇，含游荡机器人、暖色窗户和可驾驶小船，仍在开发中。
summary_en: Starting from one illustration, the author is building an explorable harbour town with Opus 5.5, Blender and Three.js, with wandering robots, lit windows and a drivable boat; still in progress.
author: @chetanankola

title: After Effects 摄影表与描线
summary: 作者在 After Effects 中测试 Opus 5.5 做摄影表节奏与描线合成：它参照风格参考推算帧曝光，经作者微调动作后自行分层完成描线，用时约 1 小时。
summary_en: The author tested Opus 5.5 in After Effects on x-sheet timing and line comping: it worked out exposures from style refs, took a nudge toward natural motion, and comped the lines in layers itself in about an hour.
author: @araminta_k

title: 用新素材一次做出应用短片
title_en: App short film from redesign assets
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 用其应用改版的新素材一次生成一部短片，音效也由 Claude 完成，并自行导出 MP4；附提示词。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 one-shot a short film of their app from new redesign assets, made all the sound and exported the MP4 itself; prompt included.
author: @jackfriks

title: Storycast 开源讲解视频生成
summary: 作者上线开源工具 Storycast：输入主题即生成带旁白的讲解视频，Opus 5.5 负责写稿与剪辑、H3 Max 负责动画；作者称为调通流程跑了约 250 次、花费约 1800 美元。
summary_en: The author launched Storycast, an open-source tool that turns a topic into a narrated explainer, with Opus 5.5 writing and editing and H3 Max animating; says tuning took ~250 runs and ~$1.8K.
author: @ailker

title: Blender 效率对比 Astra
summary: 作者在 Max 档位下用同一提示让 GPT-6 Astra 和 Opus 5.5 完成简单 Blender 任务，结果外观相近，但 Astra 用时 43 分钟、6.1 万输出 token，Opus 用了 1 小时 57 分钟、50.7 万 token，效率明显更低。
summary_en: On a simple Blender task at Max with the same prompt, the author found similar-looking results, but Astra took 43 min and 61K output tokens versus Opus 5.5's 1h57m and 507K tokens.
author: @zavrenn

title: 九种风格讲解递归
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 做一段讲解递归的视频，要求每段解释都换一种截然不同的视频风格并自我指涉，一条提示得到九次风格切换。
summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 for a self-referential recursion explainer where every explanation switches to a radically different video style, getting nine genre shifts from one prompt.
author: @emollick

summary_en: The author shares a prompt for having Opus 5.5 create a slow-reveal motion video that assembles a product logo, demonstrated with the TypingMind logo.
author: @tdinh_me

title: 自由电子激光科普视频

summary_en: The author says one prompt and about an hour got Opus 5.5 to produce an educational video on free-electron lasers, using ~1% of a Max x10 plan.

title: 讲解个人基准的重要性
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 一次生成一段解释“个人基准测试为何重要”的视频并分享。

author: @yanhua1010

title: 一张像素图做成动画
summary: 作者从自绘的 45×45 像素图出发，让 Opus 5.5 做关节绑定工具，再生成女孩用炸弹炸碎滚石的动画，森林、爆炸和音效全用代码生成、未用图像模型，经数轮文字反馈修改。

title_en: A single-file WebGL2 sandbox survival game

author: @kepochnik

title: 一句话生成可漫游 3D 宝塔
title_en: A walkable 3D pagoda from one sentence
summary: 作者仅用一句“在 3D 宝塔中导航”的提示，Opus 5.5 一次生成可自由漫游的宝塔场景，作者称仅消耗不到 5% 的日额度。
summary_en: From a one-line prompt asking to navigate a pagoda in 3D, Opus 5.5 one-shot a walkable pagoda scene; the author says it used under 5% of their daily limit.
author: @BuildFastWithAI

title: 动漫风樱花小镇 3D 漫游

summary_en: The creator built a walkable Japanese cherry-blossom town with shops, a rail crossing and a shrine using Opus 5.5 and Three.js, reporting 10 refinements for about $25; a highly detailed sectioned prompt is shared in a reply.
author: @pound75423

title: 一镜到底的人生轮回动画
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 以“动效设计师作品集”为题，一次生成约 20 秒循环动画，讲述同一人从童年到老年的一生；提示词已随帖公开。
summary_en: Framed as a motion designer's showreel, Opus 5.5 one-shot a ~20-second looping animation following one person from childhood to old age; the prompt is included in the post.
author: @loicRambo

title: 海上平台火箭发射 3D 对比

summary_en: A side-by-side of Opus 5 and 5.5 rocket launches: the 5.5 version stages a dawn ocean liftoff with stage separation, fairing release and satellite deployment, all procedural Three.js; the full prompt is in a reply.
author: @Artless101

title: 彩窗大教堂短片《余白》
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 与 three.js 制作约 36 秒竖屏无人物短片，以灰色“效率”方块与最终洒满地面的彩窗光影表达“留白”的主题；日文分镜式提示词随帖公开。

summary_en: The creator asked Opus 5.5 to invent a story that would draw attention to their app Grid Genius and render it as a 'Pixar-level' three.js animation; the prompt is shared in the post.
author: @Anilraok

title: 鹈鹕骑行海滨 3D 游戏

author: @code_hiyouga

title: 三模型同题搭建帝国之城
title_en: Three models build an Imperial City
summary: 同一句“建一座帝国之城”提示下，作者称 Opus 5.5 产出最密集的版本：带穹顶与城墙的要塞，并附侧栏列出十余个可跳转地点。
summary_en: Given the same 'build an imperial city' prompt, the author says Opus 5.5 produced the densest result: a domed, walled fortress with a side menu of a dozen-plus navigable locations.
author: @Enzoxbt01

title: 夜城横版猫咪跑酷 CatWalk
summary: 作者只给出粗略的日文需求，Opus 5.5 便做出 3D 横版自动卷轴猫咪游戏 CatWalk，氛围灯光出色，除调低音效外未再修改，已发布到 itch.io；提示词在回复中。
summary_en: From loose Japanese instructions, Opus 5.5 built CatWalk, a moody 3D auto-scrolling cat runner; the only follow-up was lowering SFX volume, and it is published on itch.io with the prompt in a reply.
author: @blitast_studio

title: Blender 赛博朋克巨城基准
summary: 作者用自设“末班列车”基准，让 Opus 5.5 在 Blender 中搭建带主角列车、高架轨道、雨雾与多机位动画的赛博朋克城市，当前为 1080p 渲染的阶段成果。
summary_en: Using their 'The Last Train' benchmark, the author had Opus 5.5 build a Blender cyberpunk megacity with a hero train, elevated rails, rain, volumetrics and multi-camera animation; shown as a 1080p work in progress.

title: 体素风足球进球动画

title: 零依赖 GPU 霓虹流体模拟

summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5's first attempt produced a single-file, dependency-free GPU Eulerian fluid sim with vorticity, chromatic aberration and a glassmorphism HUD; the full prompt is in a reply.
author: @theailoser

title: Blender 重现兴登堡号事故
title_en: Recreating the Hindenburg disaster in Blender
summary: 作者只给了“在 Blender 建兴登堡号模型并做事故写实视频”的简单要求，Opus 5.5 花约 2 小时、占周额度一半完成建模与运镜。
summary_en: With only a basic request to model the Hindenburg in Blender and render a realistic video of the accident, Opus 5.5 handled modeling and cinematography in about two hours, using half the weekly quota.
author: @aimanhasnoname

title: 照片还原 360° 手球场景
title_en: A 360° 3D handball scene from a photo
summary: 作者上传一张手球比赛照片，Opus 5.5 在 20 分钟内一次还原出可 360° 查看的 3D 场景，含球员姿态与配色；作者指出球门朝向反了。提示在回复中。

author: @chikaidev

title: 自动运行的 3D 鲁布·戈德堡机
summary: 同一提示下 Opus 5.5（Claude Code）与 GPT-6 Astra 都从零做出带物理的鲁布·戈德堡机；作者记录 Opus 耗时 62 分钟、花费 14.28 美元，约为对手 6.5 倍。完整提示在回复中。
summary_en: With an identical prompt, Opus 5.5 in Claude Code and GPT-6 Astra each built a working physics Rube Goldberg machine; Opus took 62 minutes and $14.28, about 6.5x the cost. Full prompt in the thread.
author: @leogao25

title: 绘本风农场动物 3D 游戏
summary: 作者为孩子写了随意的提示，Opus 5.5 做出绘本画风的 3D 农场游戏：可选五种动物，能跳跃、进食、喝水并“boop”其他动物；提示词在回复中公开。

author: @blaso96

title: Effort档位怎么选

title: 复刻12小时视频流程
